result.topic_en: Evaluation of the imaginary part of formula 65 at rational points $x = \frac{m}{n}2\pi$, split by parity of n, followed by series manipulations of $f(r)$ and a Latin formulation of the Cauchy convergence criterion for $a_0+a_1+a_2+\dots$.
